shots.action: Character turnaround sheet on a neutral grey background (#808080), one image, four full-body panels in a row at the same height and scale: Panel 1 front view; Panel 2 three-quarter view; Panel 3 side view; Panel 4 back view. Same character, same costume and colours in all four panels, same 5.5-head proportions. Every panel shows the same approved look: properly curly bouncy black ringlets with one peacock feather and a pearl string in the hair; layered pearl necklaces and pearl ear studs; golden pitambara; black Kali Kamli sash; a bamboo bansuri tucked in the sash; gold anklets and armlets; the playful face with a warm mischievous smile; flat cloud-blue skin (lighter, never indigo-grey, never cyan). The Vaishnava U-shaped tilak shows on the forehead in the front and three-quarter panels. Variable ink line, hard shadow planes, no rim light on this sheet. Avoid: adult proportions; a crown; a belt or buckle.
